```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
```

```{r}
deg_list <- sig_all_region_astro$gene
```

```{r}
# Assuming your DEG results have a column named "logFC"
ranked_genes <- sig_all_region_astro$logFC
names(ranked_genes) <- sig_all_region_astro$gene  # Assign gene names to the ranked vector

# Sort genes by logFC in decreasing order
ranked_genes <- sort(ranked_genes, decreasing = TRUE)
```


```{r}
gsea_results_astro <- gseGO(geneList = ranked_genes,          # The ranked gene list
                      OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,             # Database for gene annotations
                      keyType = "SYMBOL",               # Type of gene ID (e.g., SYMBOL, ENSEMBL)
                      ont = "BP",                       # GO ontology (BP: Biological Process, CC: Cellular Component, MF: Molecular Function)
                      pvalueCutoff = 0.05,              # p-value cutoff for significant results
                      verbose = FALSE)
                      
# View the top GSEA results
head(gsea_results)
```

```{r}
gsea_up_astro <- gsea_results_astro
gsea_up_astro@result <- gsea_up_astro@result[gsea_up_astro@result$NES > 0, ]

# Dot plot for upregulated pathways
dotplot(gsea_up_astro, showCategory = 10)
```


```{r}
gsea_down_astro <- gsea_results_astro
gsea_down_astro@result <- gsea_down_astro@result[gsea_down_astro@result$NES < 0, ]

# Dot plot for upregulated pathways
dotplot(gsea_down_astro, showCategory = 10)
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

# Extract NES for each cell type
pathways <- unique(c(gsea_results_astro@result$Description,
                     gsea_results_micro@result$Description,
                     gsea_results_oligo@result$Description,
                     gsea_results_opc@result$Description))

# Create a matrix with pathways as rows and cell types as columns
nes_matrix <- data.frame(
  row.names = pathways,
  Astrocytes = match(pathways, gsea_results_astro@result$Description, nomatch = 0),
  Microglia = match(pathways, gsea_results_micro@result$Description, nomatch = 0),
  Oligodendrocytes = match(pathways, gsea_results_oligo@result$Description, nomatch = 0),
  OPCs = match(pathways, gsea_results_opc@result$Description, nomatch = 0)
)

# Convert it to a matrix
nes_matrix <- as.matrix(nes_matrix)

# Plot heatmap of NES scores
pheatmap(nes_matrix, color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50), cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE)
```
```{r}
# Assuming you have a list of pathways shared across all cell types
# Extract NES for each cell type
pathways <- unique(c(gsea_results_astro@result$Description,
                     gsea_results_micro@result$Description,
                     gsea_results_oligo@result$Description,
                     gsea_results_opc@result$Description))

# Create the NES matrix by extracting NES values for each cell type
nes_matrix <- data.frame(
  row.names = pathways,  # Use the pathway names as row names
  Astrocytes = gsea_results_astro@result$NES[match(pathways, gsea_results_astro@result$Description)],
  Microglia = gsea_results_micro@result$NES[match(pathways, gsea_results_micro@result$Description)],
  Oligodendrocytes = gsea_results_oligo@result$NES[match(pathways, gsea_results_oligo@result$Description)]
)

# Convert the data frame to a matrix for easier visualization
nes_matrix <- as.matrix(nes_matrix)

# Replace any NA values (for pathways not found in a particular cell type) with 0
nes_matrix[is.na(nes_matrix)] <- 0

# Check the NES matrix to ensure it contains NES values, not counts
head(nes_matrix)
summary(nes_matrix)

```

```{r}
# Define a significance threshold (e.g., p.adjust < 0.05)
significance_threshold <- 0.05

# Filter and split pathways into upregulated (NES > 0) and downregulated (NES < 0)

# Astrocytes
astro_up <- gsea_results_astro@result[gsea_results_astro@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_astro@result$NES > 0, ]
astro_down <- gsea_results_astro@result[gsea_results_astro@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_astro@result$NES < 0, ]

# Microglia
micro_up <- gsea_results_micro@result[gsea_results_micro@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_micro@result$NES > 0, ]
micro_down <- gsea_results_micro@result[gsea_results_micro@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_micro@result$NES < 0, ]

# Oligodendrocytes
oligo_up <- gsea_results_oligo@result[gsea_results_oligo@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_oligo@result$NES > 0, ]
oligo_down <- gsea_results_oligo@result[gsea_results_oligo@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_oligo@result$NES < 0, ]

# Select top 10 upregulated and top 10 downregulated pathways based on NES

# For Astrocytes
top_astro_up <- head(astro_up[order(astro_up$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]$Description, 10)
top_astro_down <- head(astro_down[order(astro_down$NES, decreasing = FALSE), ]$Description, 10)

# For Microglia
top_micro_up <- head(micro_up[order(micro_up$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]$Description, 10)
top_micro_down <- head(micro_down[order(micro_down$NES, decreasing = FALSE), ]$Description, 10)

# For Oligodendrocytes
top_oligo_up <- head(oligo_up[order(oligo_up$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ]$Description, 10)
top_oligo_down <- head(oligo_down[order(oligo_down$NES, decreasing = FALSE), ]$Description, 10)

# Combine the top up and downregulated pathways
top_pathways_combined <- unique(c(top_astro_up, top_astro_down, top_micro_up, top_micro_down, top_oligo_up, top_oligo_down))

# Subset the NES matrix for the combined top pathways (excluding OPCs)
nes_matrix_top_combined <- nes_matrix[row.names(nes_matrix) %in% top_pathways_combined, c("Astrocytes", "Microglia", "Oligodendrocytes")]

# Plot the heatmap
pheatmap(nes_matrix_top_combined, 
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(50), 
         cluster_rows = TRUE, 
         cluster_cols = TRUE, 
         show_rownames = TRUE, 
         show_colnames = TRUE
)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Define a significance threshold
significance_threshold <- 0.05

# Extract top 10 upregulated (NES > 0) and downregulated (NES < 0) pathways for Astrocytes

# Filter significant upregulated and downregulated pathways
astro_up <- gsea_results_astro@result[gsea_results_astro@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_astro@result$NES > 0, ]
astro_down <- gsea_results_astro@result[gsea_results_astro@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_astro@result$NES < 0, ]

# Get the top 10 up and down regulated pathways based on NES
top_astro_up <- head(astro_up[order(astro_up$NES, decreasing = TRUE), ], 5)
top_astro_down <- head(astro_down[order(astro_down$NES, decreasing = FALSE), ], 5)

# Combine up and downregulated pathways
top_astro_combined <- rbind(top_astro_up, top_astro_down)

# Add a column indicating up/down regulation
top_astro_combined$regulation <- ifelse(top_astro_combined$NES > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated")

# Plot the barplot
ggplot(top_astro_combined, aes(x = reorder(Description, -p.adjust), y = NES, fill = regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +  # Flip coordinates for easier reading
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue")) +  # Color code
  labs(
    title = "Top 5 Upregulated and Downregulated Pathways in Astrocytes from PWH", 
    x = "Pathways", 
    y = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial"),  # Apply Arial font to all text
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),  # Increase y-axis (pathway names) text size
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),  # Increase x-axis (NES) text size
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.2),  # Increase title size
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)  # Increase axis title size
  )


```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Define a significance threshold
significance_threshold <- 0.05

# Extract top 10 upregulated and downregulated pathways for Astrocytes, ranked by p-value

# Filter significant upregulated and downregulated pathways
astro_up <- gsea_results_astro@result[gsea_results_astro@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_astro@result$NES > 0, ]
astro_down <- gsea_results_astro@result[gsea_results_astro@result$p.adjust < significance_threshold & gsea_results_astro@result$NES < 0, ]

# Rank by p-value and select top 10
top_astro_up <- head(astro_up[order(astro_up$p.adjust), ], 10)
top_astro_down <- head(astro_down[order(astro_down$p.adjust), ], 10)

# Combine up and downregulated pathways
top_astro_combined <- rbind(top_astro_up, top_astro_down)

# Add a column indicating up/down regulation
top_astro_combined$regulation <- ifelse(top_astro_combined$NES > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated")

# Plot the barplot
ggplot(top_astro_combined, aes(x = reorder(Description, -p.adjust), y = NES, fill = regulation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip() +  # Flip coordinates for easier reading
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Upregulated" = "red", "Downregulated" = "blue")) +  # Color code
  labs(title = "Top 10 Upregulated and Downregulated Pathways in Astrocytes (Ranked by p-value)", 
       x = "Pathways", y = "NES") +
  theme_minimal()
```
